title: World War I
text: World War I (1914-1918) was a global conflict primarily centered in Europe, triggered by the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary and fueled by a web of alliances, militarism, and nationalism. It pitted the Allied Powers (including France, Britain, Russia, and later the United States) against the Central Powers (Germany, Austria-Hungary, and others). The war introduced trench warfare and new military technology, resulting in an estimated 15-22 million deaths.
